text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear paragraphing with an opening, body examples, and a conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups ideas into a recognizable structure that makes the response easier to follow."},{"evidence":"Uses transition phrases like \"One day\" and \"In conclusion\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay links sentences and paragraphs with some explicit connectors to show progression of ideas."},{"evidence":"Maintains the same point about first impressions throughout","quality":"staying on topic","description":"The essay keeps a consistent focus on the prompt rather than drifting into unrelated detail."},{"evidence":"Sentences like \"it does't care the color of the eye, the color of the skin or what language they speak\"","quality":"ideas development","description":"The essay develops its point with explanation and examples instead of only making brief claims."},{"evidence":"Phrases such as \"he was adorable and so loving\" and \"not good to judge people\"","quality":"clarity of expression","description":"The essay communicates its intended meaning more directly and with less run-on confusion."}]}
